domain_setting: Personal introductions, address details, digital communication, and written mail.
visual_thesis: Show each object in a real communication task, using blank interface lines and symbols instead of readable text or numbers.

polysemy_resolution_table.title: A respectful honorific or formal title used to address someone; no written title is shown.
polysemy_resolution_table.job title: A role or rank held at work, shown with a workplace badge and team context.
polysemy_resolution_table.company name: The identifying mark of a business, repeated on its building and card without letters.
polysemy_resolution_table.cell phone number: A contact number used on a mobile phone; keypad circles carry no numerals.
polysemy_resolution_table.mobile number: The same phone-number sense, shown through a saved contact and cell network.
polysemy_resolution_table.house number: The identifier on a home's entrance plaque, represented without digits.
polysemy_resolution_table.state: A state or region in the address group; keep the map illustration even though the Japanese inventory gloss says condition.
polysemy_resolution_table.zip code: A postal routing code, represented with five colored blocks rather than digits.
polysemy_resolution_table.post: Covers both meanings shown on the live page: publish something online and send a physical item through the mail.
polysemy_resolution_table.draft: A saved but unfinished email, interpreted from the live lesson gloss 下書き and its email group.

existing_asset_triage.notes: All 41 existing cards were reviewed on the contact sheet and retained: their diagrams match the communication or address context. The live lesson lists city, state, and ZIP code as previously learned links to Lesson 01; the address map still uses the geographic state sense.

new_svg_from_text_only.title: Formal honorific cue: rosette, blank plaque, respectful bow.
new_svg_from_text_only.job title: Workplace role badge on a team leader above coworkers.
new_svg_from_text_only.company name: Matching abstract business mark on the office facade and a card.
new_svg_from_text_only.cell phone number: Contact avatar and blank mobile dial pad connected by a dot sequence.
new_svg_from_text_only.mobile number: Saved contact linked to a phone and cell mast.
new_svg_from_text_only.house number: House entrance with an identifying plaque represented by colored pips.
new_svg_from_text_only.zip code: Mail sorting scene with a five-block routing code on an envelope.
